name: Predicts
test: On tasks outside the class it was fitted on, including real data, the theory predicts held-out behaviour better than the kernel baseline, in a pre-registered test.

name: Explains
test: The pull toward the minimum circuit is derived from the training dynamics (a theorem or a quantitative law verified prospectively), not only observed.

name: Scales
test: The same result holds at n ≥ 8 inputs and beyond width 8, with compiler-computed completions.

name: Certified
test: Every claim the theory rests on is machine-checked or pre-registered and replicated; the ledger shows no claim stated stronger than its support.
